_comment: Human context for USE_ options, shown in the sample app's details card. 'options' entries win over 'patterns' (first match). level: core | recommended | optional | niche | hardware | platform | dev. Facts that can be derived from the source (where it is defined, MCU scope, dependencies) are computed by src/probe.ts, not written here.

levels.core: Required. The flight controller or the Configurator depends on it; removing it breaks basic operation.
levels.recommended: Used by most Rotorflight setups. Only remove it if you are sure you do not need it.
levels.optional: A real feature that many setups do not use. A good candidate to strip when flash is tight.
levels.niche: Legacy or uncommon protocol or feature. A safe strip candidate unless you use that exact equipment.
levels.hardware: Support for a specific chip or MCU peripheral. Only useful if the board actually has it.
levels.platform: Set by the build system or the MCU platform. Not a feature: never toggle it by hand.
levels.dev: Developer, debug or test switch. Do not enable in firmware you fly.

patterns.title: $3 gyro/accelerometer driver
patterns.summary: Driver for the $3 gyro/accelerometer chip.
patterns.enable: Your board's gyro is a $3.
patterns.disable: Your board uses a different gyro. Every unused IMU driver is dead flash.

patterns.title: $2 barometer driver
patterns.summary: Driver for the $2 barometric pressure sensor.
patterns.enable: Your board has a $2 baro and you use altitude/vario data.
patterns.disable: No such chip on your board. Baro data is rarely used on helicopters.

patterns.title: $2 magnetometer driver
patterns.summary: Driver for the $2 compass chip.
patterns.enable: You fit that compass, usually as part of a GPS module.
patterns.disable: No compass of that type is fitted.

patterns.title: $1 flash chip driver
patterns.summary: Driver for the $1 SPI flash chip used for onboard blackbox logging.
patterns.enable: Your board logs to a $1 chip.
patterns.disable: Your board has a different flash chip, or no onboard flash.

patterns.title: UART$1
patterns.summary: Enables hardware serial port $1.
patterns.enable: The MCU has UART$1 and the board routes it to pads.
patterns.disable: The MCU does not have UART$1. Removing a UART that does exist loses a serial port.

patterns.title: UART$2 $3 DMA
patterns.summary: Uses DMA for UART$2 $3 instead of interrupts.
patterns.enable: Only when the board's DMA mapping is designed for it.
patterns.disable: Normally decided by the board's hardware design, not per build.

patterns.title: SPI bus $1
patterns.summary: Enables SPI peripheral $1.
patterns.enable: The MCU has SPI$1 and the board uses it.
patterns.disable: The MCU does not have SPI$1.

patterns.title: I2C bus $1
patterns.summary: Enables I2C peripheral $1.
patterns.enable: The MCU has I2C$1 and the board uses it.
patterns.disable: The MCU does not have I2C$1.

patterns.title: $1 serial receiver
patterns.summary: Decodes the $1 serial receiver protocol.
patterns.enable: Your receiver talks $1.
patterns.disable: You use a different receiver protocol. Each unused protocol is a strip candidate.

patterns.title: $1 telemetry
patterns.summary: Sends flight data back to the transmitter over the $1 telemetry protocol.
patterns.enable: Your radio system uses $1 telemetry.
patterns.disable: Your radio uses a different telemetry protocol.

patterns.title: $1$2 SPI receiver
patterns.summary: Support for a receiver chip wired directly to the flight controller's SPI bus (built-in receiver).
patterns.enable: Your board has an on-board $1 receiver chip.
patterns.disable: Helicopter boards almost always use an external serial receiver instead.

patterns.title: Spektrum $1
patterns.summary: Extra Spektrum receiver feature ($1).
patterns.enable: You fly a Spektrum receiver and want this feature.
patterns.disable: You do not use Spektrum.

patterns.title: Fake $1
patterns.summary: A simulated $1 device for the SITL simulator and bench testing.
patterns.enable: Only for simulator or bench-test builds.
patterns.disable: Never in flight firmware: it reports made-up sensor data.

patterns.summary: MCU-specific platform code (ST HAL / startup workaround).
patterns.enable: Set automatically for the MCU that needs it.
patterns.disable: Never toggle by hand.

patterns.title: USB stack: $1
patterns.summary: USB controller and stack configuration for a particular MCU family.
patterns.enable: Set by the MCU's USB stack.
patterns.disable: Never toggle by hand: it must match the USB hardware.

patterns.title: VTX $1
patterns.summary: Video transmitter control ($1).
patterns.enable: You fly FPV with a controllable video transmitter.
patterns.disable: No FPV video transmitter. Very rarely used on helicopters.

patterns.title: OSD $1
patterns.summary: On-screen display feature: $1.
patterns.enable: You fly FPV and use the OSD.
patterns.disable: No FPV goggles or OSD in your setup.

patterns.title: CMS menu: $1
patterns.summary: An extra menu in the stick-driven on-screen configuration menus.
patterns.enable: You configure the model from goggles or the radio screen.
patterns.disable: You only use the Configurator or Lua scripts.

patterns.title: GPS: $1
patterns.summary: GPS sub-feature: $1.
patterns.enable: You fit a GPS and use this sub-feature.
patterns.disable: No GPS fitted.

patterns.title: 4-way interface: $1
patterns.summary: Lets ESC configuration tools talk to the ESCs through the flight controller.
patterns.enable: You configure or flash ESCs through the FC.
patterns.disable: Your ESCs are programmed another way, e.g. a dedicated programming card.

USE_GYRO.title: Gyro
USE_GYRO.summary: Gyro sensor support: the input every stabilisation loop is built on.
USE_GYRO.disable: Never: a flight controller without a gyro cannot fly.

USE_ACC.title: Accelerometer
USE_ACC.summary: Accelerometer support, used for attitude estimation, self-levelling and rescue.
USE_ACC.enable: Needed for rescue, angle/horizon modes and attitude in logs and OSD.
USE_ACC.disable: Removing it disables rescue and every levelling mode.

USE_SERVOS.title: Servo output
USE_SERVOS.summary: Servo outputs: swashplate and tail control on a helicopter.

USE_PWM_OUTPUT.title: PWM output
USE_PWM_OUTPUT.summary: Timer-driven PWM outputs for servos and motors.

USE_PWM.title: PWM receiver input
USE_PWM.summary: Reads a receiver that has one PWM wire per channel.
USE_PWM.enable: You use an old-style PWM receiver.
USE_PWM.disable: You use a serial receiver (the normal case).

USE_PPM.title: PPM receiver input
USE_PPM.summary: Reads a single-wire PPM-sum receiver signal.

USE_TIMER.title: Hardware timers
USE_TIMER.summary: MCU timer support behind every PWM, DShot and frequency input.

USE_TIMER_MGMT.title: Timer resource management
USE_TIMER_MGMT.summary: Lets the CLI and board configs remap timers to pins.
USE_TIMER_MGMT.disable: Board configs would no longer apply.

USE_DMA.title: DMA
USE_DMA.summary: Direct memory access, used by DShot, SPI, LED strip and more.

USE_DMA_SPEC.title: DMA mapping
USE_DMA_SPEC.summary: Lets board configs choose DMA streams per peripheral.
USE_DMA_SPEC.disable: Board configs would no longer apply.

USE_ADC.title: ADC
USE_ADC.summary: Analog inputs: battery voltage, current sensor, BEC voltage.
USE_ADC.disable: Loses all voltage and current sensing.

USE_SPI.title: SPI
USE_SPI.summary: SPI bus support, which the gyro and flash chips sit on.
USE_SPI.disable: Never: the gyro would be unreachable.

USE_I2C.title: I2C
USE_I2C.summary: I2C bus support for baro, compass and OLED displays.
USE_I2C.enable: Most boards wire a baro or external sensors to I2C.
USE_I2C.disable: Only if nothing on the board or model uses I2C.

USE_UART.title: UARTs
USE_UART.disable: Never: the receiver and telemetry use UARTs.

USE_VCP.title: USB serial (VCP)
USE_VCP.summary: The USB virtual COM port the Configurator connects through.
USE_VCP.disable: Never: you would lose USB configuration.

USE_CLI.title: CLI
USE_CLI.summary: The command-line interface used by the Configurator's CLI tab, diff/dump and board configs.
USE_CLI.disable: Never: backups, presets and board configs all go through it.

USE_CLI_BATCH.title: CLI batch mode
USE_CLI_BATCH.summary: Applies a pasted CLI diff as one batch, aborting cleanly on errors.
USE_CLI_BATCH.enable: Restoring backups and presets relies on it.
USE_CLI_BATCH.disable: Small saving, but makes restores fragile.

USE_SERIAL_RX.title: Serial receivers
USE_SERIAL_RX.summary: The framework for every serial receiver protocol.
USE_SERIAL_RX.enable: Always: nearly every modern receiver is serial.

USE_IMU_CALC.title: Attitude estimation
USE_IMU_CALC.summary: Computes the model's attitude from gyro and accelerometer.

USE_RESOURCE_MGMT.title: Resource remapping
USE_RESOURCE_MGMT.summary: The CLI 'resource' command that maps functions to pins.
USE_RESOURCE_MGMT.enable: Unified-target board configs are made of resource commands.
USE_RESOURCE_MGMT.disable: Board configs would no longer apply.

USE_UNIFIED_TARGET.title: Unified target
USE_UNIFIED_TARGET.summary: Marks this as a unified (one firmware, many boards) build.

USE_CUSTOM_DEFAULTS.title: Board config defaults
USE_CUSTOM_DEFAULTS.summary: Stores the board's config (pins, sensors) in flash so a unified target knows what board it is on.

USE_CUSTOM_DEFAULTS_ADDRESS.title: Board config location
USE_CUSTOM_DEFAULTS_ADDRESS.summary: Fixed flash location for the board config.

USE_BOARD_INFO.title: Board info
USE_BOARD_INFO.summary: Stores the board name and manufacturer ID. This is what 'Detect board' reads.
USE_BOARD_INFO.enable: Board detection and board configs rely on it.

USE_SIGNATURE.title: Board signature
USE_SIGNATURE.summary: A per-board signature stored alongside the board info.
USE_SIGNATURE.enable: Used by the Configurator's board identification.
USE_SIGNATURE.disable: Small saving; the Configurator loses the signature.

USE_DSHOT.title: DShot
USE_DSHOT.enable: Your main or tail ESC is driven by DShot.
USE_DSHOT.disable: Your ESCs use PWM throttle (common on helicopters). DShot telemetry and the RPM filter depend on it.

USE_DSHOT_TELEMETRY.title: Bidirectional DShot
USE_DSHOT_TELEMETRY.summary: Reads motor RPM back over the DShot signal wire.
USE_DSHOT_TELEMETRY.enable: It feeds the RPM filter and governor from DShot ESCs.
USE_DSHOT_TELEMETRY.disable: No DShot ESCs; RPM comes from ESC telemetry or a frequency sensor instead.

USE_DSHOT_TELEMETRY_STATS.title: DShot telemetry stats
USE_DSHOT_TELEMETRY_STATS.disable: Small saving when DShot works fine.

USE_DSHOT_BITBANG.title: Bitbanged DShot
USE_DSHOT_BITBANG.summary: DShot produced by GPIO bit-banging, freeing timers.
USE_DSHOT_BITBANG.enable: Many boards need it for bidirectional DShot.
USE_DSHOT_BITBANG.disable: Only if DShot is not used.

USE_DSHOT_DMAR.title: DShot burst DMA
USE_DSHOT_DMAR.enable: When the board's timer and DMA layout calls for it.

USE_RPM_FILTER.title: RPM filter
USE_RPM_FILTER.summary: Notch filters that track headspeed and tail RPM to remove rotor and motor vibration from the gyro.
USE_RPM_FILTER.enable: Strongly recommended for helicopters. It needs an RPM source.
USE_RPM_FILTER.disable: No RPM source available. You lose the most effective vibration filter.

USE_DYN_NOTCH_FILTER.title: Dynamic notch
USE_DYN_NOTCH_FILTER.summary: FFT-based notch that finds and removes vibration peaks automatically.
USE_DYN_NOTCH_FILTER.enable: Useful with or without an RPM source.
USE_DYN_NOTCH_FILTER.disable: Saves CPU and flash if your RPM filter covers everything.

USE_DYN_LPF.title: Dynamic low-pass
USE_DYN_LPF.summary: Low-pass filter whose cutoff moves with throttle.

USE_GYRO_LPF2.title: Second gyro low-pass
USE_GYRO_LPF2.summary: An extra gyro low-pass filter stage.
USE_GYRO_LPF2.enable: Your tune uses the second LPF.

USE_GYRO_OVERFLOW_CHECK.title: Gyro overflow check
USE_GYRO_OVERFLOW_CHECK.summary: Detects gyro readings that wrap around on violent rotation.

USE_FREQ_SENSOR.title: Frequency sensor
USE_FREQ_SENSOR.summary: Measures RPM from a pulse or phase signal on an input pin (Rotorflight).
USE_FREQ_SENSOR.enable: Your headspeed or tail RPM comes from a frequency sensor or an ESC RPM output wire.
USE_FREQ_SENSOR.disable: RPM comes from DShot or ESC telemetry instead.

USE_ESC_SENSOR.title: ESC telemetry
USE_ESC_SENSOR.summary: Reads serial telemetry (RPM, voltage, current, temperature) from the ESC. Rotorflight supports many helicopter ESC protocols.
USE_ESC_SENSOR.enable: Your ESC has a telemetry wire. It is a common RPM source for the governor and RPM filter.

USE_ESC_SENSOR_TELEMETRY.title: Forward ESC telemetry
USE_ESC_SENSOR_TELEMETRY.summary: Passes ESC sensor values on to radio telemetry.
USE_ESC_SENSOR_TELEMETRY.enable: You want ESC data on the transmitter.
USE_ESC_SENSOR_TELEMETRY.disable: No ESC telemetry, or you do not display it.

USE_TELEMETRY.title: Telemetry
USE_TELEMETRY.summary: The framework for all radio telemetry protocols.
USE_TELEMETRY.enable: Almost every setup sends telemetry to the radio.

USE_TELEMETRY_CRSF.title: CRSF telemetry
USE_TELEMETRY_CRSF.summary: Telemetry for Crossfire and ExpressLRS receivers.
USE_TELEMETRY_CRSF.enable: You fly CRSF or ELRS (very common).

USE_TELEMETRY_SBUS2.title: Futaba SBUS2 telemetry
USE_TELEMETRY_SBUS2.enable: You fly Futaba with an SBUS2 receiver.

USE_TELEMETRY_CASTLE.title: Castle Link telemetry
USE_TELEMETRY_CASTLE.summary: Reads Castle Creations ESC telemetry over the throttle signal (Castle Link).
USE_TELEMETRY_CASTLE.enable: You use a Castle ESC with Link telemetry.

USE_SMARTFUEL.title: Smart fuel
USE_SMARTFUEL.summary: Estimates remaining battery capacity from voltage and current (Rotorflight).
USE_SMARTFUEL.enable: You want a fuel percentage on the radio or OSD.
USE_SMARTFUEL.disable: You do not use a fuel gauge.

USE_SBUS_OUTPUT.title: SBUS output
USE_SBUS_OUTPUT.summary: Drives servos or other devices with an SBUS signal from the FC (Rotorflight).
USE_SBUS_OUTPUT.enable: You run SBUS servos or an SBUS-input device from the FC.
USE_SBUS_OUTPUT.disable: Servos are on ordinary PWM outputs.

USE_FBUS_MASTER.title: FBUS master
USE_FBUS_MASTER.summary: FrSky FBUS master: drives FBUS servos and collects sensor data on one wire (Rotorflight).
USE_FBUS_MASTER.enable: You use FrSky FBUS servos or sensors.

USE_SPORT_MASTER.title: S.Port master
USE_SPORT_MASTER.summary: Polls FrSky S.Port sensors connected to the FC (Rotorflight).
USE_SPORT_MASTER.enable: You plug FrSky sensors into the FC.

USE_BUS_SERVO.title: Bus servo
USE_BUS_SERVO.summary: Shared configuration for bus-driven servos (SBUS/FBUS output). Derived automatically.
USE_BUS_SERVO.enable: Defined automatically when SBUS output or FBUS master is on.

USE_SERVO_GEOMETRY_CORRECTION.title: Servo geometry correction
USE_SERVO_GEOMETRY_CORRECTION.summary: Corrects servo-arm geometry for linear swashplate movement (Rotorflight).
USE_SERVO_GEOMETRY_CORRECTION.enable: Improves swashplate linearity on most helicopters.
USE_SERVO_GEOMETRY_CORRECTION.disable: Small saving; you lose the correction.

USE_ACRO_TRAINER.title: Acro trainer
USE_ACRO_TRAINER.summary: Limits bank angle in acro mode for training.
USE_ACRO_TRAINER.enable: You are learning to fly acro.

USE_BLACKBOX.title: Blackbox logging
USE_BLACKBOX.summary: High-rate flight logging to flash, SD card or serial.
USE_BLACKBOX.enable: Essential for tuning and diagnosing problems.
USE_BLACKBOX.disable: Large saving, but you lose your main diagnostic tool.

USE_FLASHFS.title: Flash filesystem
USE_FLASHFS.summary: The filesystem on the onboard flash chip, used for blackbox logs.
USE_FLASHFS.enable: Your board logs to onboard flash.

USE_SDCARD.title: SD card
USE_SDCARD.summary: SD card support for blackbox logs.
USE_SDCARD.enable: Your board has an SD card slot.

USE_USB_MSC.title: USB mass storage
USE_USB_MSC.summary: Mounts the log flash or SD card as a USB drive to download logs.
USE_USB_MSC.disable: Logs can still be downloaded through the Configurator, just slower.

USE_GPS.title: GPS
USE_GPS.summary: GPS receiver support: speed, position and altitude for telemetry, logs and OSD.
USE_GPS.enable: You fit a GPS (speed runs, logging, telemetry).
USE_GPS.disable: No GPS fitted. A large and common strip candidate.

USE_GPS_RESCUE.title: GPS rescue
USE_GPS_RESCUE.enable: Only if you rely on GPS return-to-home. Check that your Rotorflight version exposes it.
USE_GPS_RESCUE.disable: Helicopters normally use the attitude-based rescue instead.

USE_LED_STRIP.title: LED strip
USE_LED_STRIP.enable: You fit LED strips for orientation or status.
USE_LED_STRIP.disable: No LEDs. Measured at about 11 KB on STM32F405.

USE_LED_STRIP_STATUS_MODE.title: LED status mode
USE_LED_STRIP_STATUS_MODE.summary: The LED strip 'status' mode (warnings, flight-mode colours).
USE_LED_STRIP_STATUS_MODE.disable: No LED strip; removed automatically with it.

USE_BEEPER.title: Beeper
USE_BEEPER.summary: Buzzer support for arming, low-battery and lost-model alerts.

USE_OSD.title: OSD
USE_OSD.summary: On-screen display overlay for FPV video.

USE_CMS.title: On-screen menus (CMS)
USE_CMS.summary: Stick-driven configuration menus shown in goggles or on the radio.
USE_CMS.enable: You change settings from the field without a computer.
USE_CMS.disable: You only use the Configurator or Lua scripts.

USE_MSP_DISPLAYPORT.title: MSP DisplayPort
USE_MSP_DISPLAYPORT.summary: Draws OSD and menus on digital FPV systems over MSP.

USE_MSP_OVER_TELEMETRY.title: MSP over telemetry
USE_MSP_OVER_TELEMETRY.summary: Carries Configurator (MSP) messages over the radio link. This is how the Rotorflight Lua scripts on your transmitter work.
USE_MSP_OVER_TELEMETRY.enable: You tune from the transmitter with the Lua scripts.
USE_MSP_OVER_TELEMETRY.disable: You never use the transmitter scripts.

USE_RX_MSP.title: MSP receiver
USE_RX_MSP.enable: Testing, or a companion computer sending stick commands.
USE_RX_MSP.disable: Normal radios do not need it.

USE_CRSF_LINK_STATISTICS.title: CRSF link statistics
USE_CRSF_LINK_STATISTICS.summary: Uses CRSF/ELRS link-quality frames for RSSI and LQ.

USE_RX_RSSI_DBM.title: RSSI in dBm
USE_RX_RSSI_DBM.summary: Reports receiver signal strength in dBm.
USE_RX_RSSI_DBM.enable: CRSF/ELRS users who log or display RSSI.

USE_SERIAL_PASSTHROUGH.title: Serial passthrough
USE_SERIAL_PASSTHROUGH.summary: Bridges USB to a UART so tools can reach a receiver, ESC or GPS behind the FC.
USE_SERIAL_PASSTHROUGH.enable: Flashing receivers or configuring ESCs and GPS through the FC.

USE_BLHELI_FORWARD_PROGRAMMING.title: BLHeli forward programming
USE_BLHELI_FORWARD_PROGRAMMING.summary: Programs BLHeli ESCs through the FC.

USE_AM32_FORWARD_PROGRAMMING.title: AM32 forward programming
USE_AM32_FORWARD_PROGRAMMING.summary: Programs AM32 ESCs through the FC.

USE_ESCSERIAL.title: ESC serial
USE_ESCSERIAL.summary: Serial link to ESC bootloaders for flashing.
USE_ESCSERIAL.enable: You flash ESC firmware through the FC.

USE_ESCSERIAL_SIMONK.title: SimonK ESC serial
USE_ESCSERIAL_SIMONK.summary: Flashing support for legacy SimonK ESCs.

USE_PINIO.title: PINIO
USE_PINIO.summary: User-controlled GPIO pins, e.g. to switch a VTX or camera power.
USE_PINIO.enable: Your board has switchable power pads you use.

USE_PINIOBOX.title: PINIO modes
USE_PINIOBOX.summary: Maps PINIO pins to switch modes.
USE_PINIOBOX.enable: You use PINIO from a switch.

USE_DASHBOARD.title: OLED dashboard
USE_DASHBOARD.summary: Status pages on a small I2C OLED display.

USE_MULTI_GYRO.title: Multiple gyros
USE_MULTI_GYRO.summary: Uses two gyro chips on boards that have them.

USE_PERSISTENT_STATS.title: Persistent stats
USE_PERSISTENT_STATS.summary: Keeps lifetime flight-count and flight-time statistics.

USE_PROFILE_NAMES.title: Profile names
USE_PROFILE_NAMES.summary: Lets you name PID and rate profiles.

USE_RTC_TIME.title: Real-time clock
USE_RTC_TIME.summary: Keeps wall-clock time (set by the Configurator or GPS) for log timestamps.

USE_HUFFMAN.title: Huffman compression
USE_HUFFMAN.summary: Compresses MSP data, e.g. for faster log download.

USE_SENSOR_NAMES.title: Sensor names
USE_SENSOR_NAMES.summary: Reports sensor chip names to the Configurator.
USE_SENSOR_NAMES.enable: Shows which gyro and baro were detected.

USE_VARIO.title: Vario
USE_VARIO.enable: You fit a baro or GPS and want vario telemetry.

USE_RANGEFINDER.title: Rangefinder
USE_RANGEFINDER.summary: Distance-sensor (sonar/lidar) support. Off by default on every target.
USE_RANGEFINDER.enable: Experimental: you fit a supported rangefinder.
USE_RANGEFINDER.disable: Measured at about 1.7 KB on STM32F405 (with HC-SR04).

USE_CAMERA_CONTROL.title: Camera control
USE_CAMERA_CONTROL.summary: Emulates FPV camera OSD-menu button presses.

USE_CANVAS.title: OSD canvas
USE_CANVAS.summary: Drawing primitives for OSD systems that support them.
USE_CANVAS.enable: Your OSD system uses canvas drawing.

USE_FRSKYOSD.title: FrSky OSD
USE_FRSKYOSD.summary: Support for the FrSky OSD module.

USE_HOTT_TEXTMODE.title: HoTT text mode
USE_HOTT_TEXTMODE.summary: Graupner HoTT text-menu configuration from the transmitter.

USE_I2C_OLED_DISPLAY.title: I2C OLED display
USE_I2C_OLED_DISPLAY.summary: Driver for small I2C OLED displays.

USE_BST.title: TBS BST bus
USE_BST.summary: Team BlackSheep BST I2C bus (old Crossfire and Core PNP).

USE_BUTTONS.title: Board buttons
USE_BUTTONS.summary: Support for physical buttons on the board.
USE_BUTTONS.enable: The board has buttons, e.g. a bind button.

USE_RX_SPI.title: SPI receiver
USE_RX_SPI.summary: Framework for receiver chips wired to SPI.
USE_RX_SPI.enable: Board with a built-in receiver chip.

USE_INVERTER.title: Serial inverter
USE_INVERTER.summary: Drives an external signal inverter. F4 UARTs cannot invert in hardware, so SBUS needs one.
USE_INVERTER.enable: F4 boards with an SBUS inverter.
USE_INVERTER.disable: F7, H7 and G4 invert in hardware.

USE_SOFTSERIAL1.title: Soft serial 1
USE_SOFTSERIAL1.summary: A serial port bit-banged on a timer pin.
USE_SOFTSERIAL1.enable: You need one more serial port than the MCU has.

USE_SOFTSERIAL2.title: Soft serial 2
USE_SOFTSERIAL2.enable: You need two extra serial ports.

USE_SERIAL_PINSWAP.title: UART pin swap
USE_SERIAL_PINSWAP.summary: Swaps UART TX/RX pins in hardware. Not available on F4.
USE_SERIAL_PINSWAP.enable: Set for MCUs whose UARTs support it.

USE_CONFIG_ERASE.title: Config erase marker
USE_CONFIG_ERASE.summary: Set by the release build (FLASH_CONFIG_ERASE=yes). Erases stored settings on first boot after flashing.
USE_CONFIG_ERASE.enable: Use the FLASH_CONFIG_ERASE checkbox, not this toggle.

USE_EXST.title: External storage boot (EXST)
USE_EXST.summary: Builds for boards that run firmware from external flash (some H7). Set by the build with EXST=yes.
USE_EXST.enable: Only for EXST boards, via the make variable.

USE_STDPERIPH_DRIVER.title: ST Standard Peripheral Library
USE_STDPERIPH_DRIVER.summary: The legacy ST driver library that F4 builds use. Set by the build.

USE_HAL_DRIVER.title: ST HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer)
USE_HAL_DRIVER.summary: ST's HAL driver library. F7, H7 and G4 builds are written against it, and make/mcu/*.mk sets it for them.
USE_HAL_DRIVER.enable: Set automatically for F7/H7/G4. Required there.
USE_HAL_DRIVER.disable: Never toggle by hand. It does not apply to F4, which uses StdPeriph.

USE_FULL_LL_DRIVER.title: ST Low-Layer drivers
USE_FULL_LL_DRIVER.summary: ST's low-layer (LL) drivers, set with HAL for F7/H7/G4 by make/mcu/*.mk.

USE_ITCM_RAM.title: ITCM RAM
USE_ITCM_RAM.summary: Places hot code in tightly-coupled instruction RAM (F7/H7).
USE_ITCM_RAM.enable: Set by the MCU's memory layout.

USE_CCM_CODE.title: CCM RAM code
USE_CCM_CODE.summary: Places code in core-coupled RAM (MCUs that have CCM).
USE_CCM_CODE.enable: Set by the MCU's memory layout.

USE_DMA_RAM.title: DMA RAM region
USE_DMA_RAM.summary: Separate RAM region for DMA buffers (H7/G4 memory layout).
USE_DMA_RAM.enable: Set by the MCU's memory layout.

USE_FAST_DATA.title: Fast data RAM
USE_FAST_DATA.summary: Places hot data in the fastest RAM.
USE_FAST_DATA.enable: Set by the MCU's memory layout.

USE_OVERCLOCK.title: Overclock
USE_OVERCLOCK.summary: Allows running the MCU above its rated clock.
USE_OVERCLOCK.enable: Leave as the target defines it.

USE_MCO.title: Clock output (MCO)
USE_MCO.summary: Outputs an MCU clock on a pin.

USE_PERSISTENT_OBJECTS.title: Persistent RAM objects
USE_PERSISTENT_OBJECTS.summary: RAM that survives a soft reset, used for reboot-to-bootloader requests.

USE_FLASH_TOOLS.title: Flash chip tools
USE_FLASH_TOOLS.summary: Erase and usage commands for the onboard flash.

USE_FLASH_CHIP.title: Flash chip support
USE_FLASH_CHIP.summary: Generic SPI flash support behind the chip drivers.

USE_FLASHFS_LOOP.title: Looping flash log
USE_FLASHFS_LOOP.summary: Overwrites the oldest blackbox data when the flash is full.

USE_GYRO_REGISTER_DUMP.title: Gyro register dump
USE_GYRO_REGISTER_DUMP.summary: CLI command that dumps gyro chip registers.
USE_GYRO_REGISTER_DUMP.disable: Not needed for flying. Small saving.

USE_LATE_TASK_STATISTICS.title: Late task statistics
USE_LATE_TASK_STATISTICS.summary: Scheduler statistics about tasks that ran late.

USE_MIXER_HISTORY.title: Mixer history
USE_MIXER_HISTORY.summary: Keeps a history of mixer outputs for debugging.

USE_GYRO_SLEW_LIMITER.title: Gyro slew limiter
USE_GYRO_SLEW_LIMITER.summary: Clamps impossible jumps in gyro readings.

USE_DEBUG_PIN.title: Debug pin
USE_DEBUG_PIN.summary: Toggles a GPIO for oscilloscope timing measurements.

USE_SERIAL_PRINTF.title: Serial printf
USE_SERIAL_PRINTF.summary: printf debugging over a serial port.

USE_ITM_PRINTF.title: ITM printf
USE_ITM_PRINTF.summary: printf debugging over the SWD trace port.

USE_FULL_ASSERT.title: Full assert
USE_FULL_ASSERT.summary: Enables the ST library's parameter assertions.

USE_OLED_GPS_DEBUG_PAGE_ONLY.title: OLED GPS debug page
USE_OLED_GPS_DEBUG_PAGE_ONLY.summary: Shows only the GPS debug page on the OLED dashboard.

USE_STM3210C_EVAL.title: ST eval board
USE_STM3210C_EVAL.summary: Leftover from ST's USB library for their evaluation board.

USE_TARGET_CONFIG.title: Target config hook
USE_TARGET_CONFIG.summary: Hook for legacy (non-unified) targets to apply their own defaults.

USE_HARDWARE_REVISION_DETECTION.title: Hardware revision detection
USE_HARDWARE_REVISION_DETECTION.summary: Detects the board's hardware revision (some legacy targets).

USE_SPRACING_PERSISTENT_RTC_WORKAROUND.title: SPRacing RTC workaround
USE_SPRACING_PERSISTENT_RTC_WORKAROUND.summary: Workaround for a specific SPRacing bootloader.

USE_TXRX_LED.title: TX/RX LED
USE_TXRX_LED.summary: Blinks an LED on serial activity (legacy).

USE_LPUART1.title: Low-power UART 1
USE_LPUART1.summary: The low-power UART found on G4 and H7 MCUs.
USE_LPUART1.enable: The MCU has an LPUART and the board uses it.
USE_LPUART1.disable: F4 and F7 have no LPUART.

USE_DSHOT_CACHE_MGMT.title: DShot cache management
USE_DSHOT_CACHE_MGMT.summary: Data-cache maintenance for DShot DMA buffers on MCUs with a D-cache (F7/H7).
USE_DSHOT_CACHE_MGMT.enable: Set for MCUs with a data cache.

USE_LEDSTRIP_CACHE_MGMT.title: LED strip cache management
USE_LEDSTRIP_CACHE_MGMT.summary: Data-cache maintenance for LED strip DMA buffers (F7/H7).
USE_LEDSTRIP_CACHE_MGMT.enable: Set for MCUs with a data cache.

USE_DMA_REGISTER_CACHE.title: DMA register cache
USE_DMA_REGISTER_CACHE.summary: Caches DMA register setups for faster DShot (MCU-specific).

USE_SBUS_CHANNELS.title: SBUS channel decoding
USE_SBUS_CHANNELS.summary: Shared SBUS-style channel decoding used by SBUS, FPort and FBUS.

USE_BARO.title: Barometer
USE_BARO.enable: Your board or model has a baro and you use altitude data.
USE_BARO.disable: Rarely used on helicopters. A reasonable strip candidate.

USE_MAG.title: Magnetometer
USE_MAG.enable: You fit a compass, usually on a GPS module.
USE_MAG.disable: No compass. Rarely needed on helicopters.

USE_MAX7456.title: Analog OSD chip (MAX7456)
USE_MAX7456.summary: Driver for the analog-video OSD chip found on many F4/F7 boards.
USE_MAX7456.enable: Your board has an analog OSD chip and you fly analog FPV.
USE_MAX7456.disable: No OSD chip, or no analog FPV.

USE_SDCARD_SDIO.title: SD card over SDIO
USE_SDCARD_SDIO.summary: Fast 4-bit SDIO connection to an SD card slot.
USE_SDCARD_SDIO.enable: Your board's SD slot is wired to SDIO.
USE_SDCARD_SDIO.disable: No SD slot, or it is wired to SPI.

USE_SDCARD_SPI.title: SD card over SPI
USE_SDCARD_SPI.summary: SD card slot connected over SPI.
USE_SDCARD_SPI.enable: Your board's SD slot is wired to SPI.
USE_SDCARD_SPI.disable: No SD slot, or it uses SDIO.

USE_SPI_GYRO.title: SPI gyro bus
USE_SPI_GYRO.summary: Gyro connected over SPI: the normal arrangement on modern boards.

USE_I2C_GYRO.title: I2C gyro bus
USE_I2C_GYRO.enable: Very old boards with an I2C gyro.

USE_DUAL_GYRO.title: Dual gyro (deprecated)
USE_DUAL_GYRO.summary: Deprecated name; the firmware raises an #error if a target defines it. Replaced by USE_MULTI_GYRO.

USE_RX_BIND.title: Receiver bind from FC
USE_RX_BIND.summary: Starts receiver binding from the Configurator (SPI receivers and some serial protocols).
USE_RX_BIND.enable: You bind the receiver through the FC.

USE_RX_LINK_QUALITY_INFO.title: Link quality info
USE_RX_LINK_QUALITY_INFO.summary: Reports receiver link quality (LQ) separately from RSSI.

USE_RX_LINK_UPLINK_POWER.title: Uplink power
USE_RX_LINK_UPLINK_POWER.summary: Reports the transmitter's uplink power level (CRSF).

USE_CRSF_V3.title: CRSF v3
USE_CRSF_V3.summary: CRSF protocol v3 features, such as faster baud negotiation.

USE_CRSF_CMS_TELEMETRY.title: CMS over CRSF
USE_CRSF_CMS_TELEMETRY.summary: Shows the on-screen menus on CRSF radios.
USE_CRSF_CMS_TELEMETRY.enable: You use CMS menus from a CRSF radio.

USE_EMFAT_AUTORUN.title: USB drive autorun file
USE_EMFAT_AUTORUN.summary: Adds an autorun file to the USB log drive.

USE_EMFAT_ICON.title: USB drive icon
USE_EMFAT_ICON.summary: Adds a drive icon to the USB log drive.

USE_EMFAT_README.title: USB drive readme
USE_EMFAT_README.summary: Adds a readme file to the USB log drive.

USE_PERSISTENT_MSC_RTC.title: Keep clock across USB-drive reboot
USE_PERSISTENT_MSC_RTC.summary: Preserves the real-time clock when rebooting into USB mass-storage mode, so log files get correct dates.

USE_PIN_PULL_UP_DOWN.title: Pin pull-up/down
USE_PIN_PULL_UP_DOWN.summary: Configurable pull-up or pull-down resistors on input pins (CLI 'pullup').
USE_PIN_PULL_UP_DOWN.enable: Your wiring needs a pull resistor on an input.

USE_FLASH_BOOT_LOADER.title: Flash bootloader
USE_FLASH_BOOT_LOADER.summary: Support for boards that boot through a separate flash bootloader.

USE_FLASH_READS_USING_4LINES.title: Quad-line flash reads
USE_FLASH_READS_USING_4LINES.summary: Reads the W25Q128 flash over 4 data lines (QSPI boards).

USE_FLASH_WRITES_USING_4LINES.title: Quad-line flash writes
USE_FLASH_WRITES_USING_4LINES.summary: Writes the W25Q128 flash over 4 data lines (QSPI boards).

USE_EXTENDED_SPI_DEVICE.title: Extra SPI DMA mappings
USE_EXTENDED_SPI_DEVICE.summary: DMA request mappings for SPI buses 4-6 on MCUs that have them.

USE_CRS_INTERRUPTS.title: Clock recovery interrupts
USE_CRS_INTERRUPTS.summary: H7 clock-recovery-system interrupts for USB timing.

USE_MCO_OUTPUTS.title: Clock outputs
USE_MCO_OUTPUTS.summary: MCU clock output pins (H7 system code).

USE_I2C_PULLUP.title: I2C internal pull-ups
USE_I2C_PULLUP.summary: Uses the MCU's internal pull-ups on I2C pins.
USE_I2C_PULLUP.enable: Boards without external I2C pull-up resistors.

USE_MPU9250_MAG.title: MPU9250 built-in compass
USE_MPU9250_MAG.summary: Uses the compass inside an MPU9250 IMU.
USE_MPU9250_MAG.enable: Board with an MPU9250 and you want its compass.

USE_WS2811_SINGLE_COLOUR.title: Single-colour LED strip
USE_WS2811_SINGLE_COLOUR.summary: Smaller LED strip driver that sends one colour to every LED.
USE_WS2811_SINGLE_COLOUR.enable: You want simple one-colour LEDs and a smaller driver.

USE_MSP_UART.title: MSP on UART
USE_MSP_UART.summary: Default MSP on a hardware UART (for boards without USB).

USE_MSP_PUSH_OVER_VCP.title: MSP push over USB
USE_MSP_PUSH_OVER_VCP.summary: Pushes MSP messages over USB unprompted.

USE_MSP_SET_MOTOR.title: MSP motor test
USE_MSP_SET_MOTOR.summary: Allows setting motor outputs over MSP.

USE_STANDARD_MATH.title: Standard math library
USE_STANDARD_MATH.summary: Uses libm functions instead of the firmware's fast approximations.

USE_4WAY_FORWARD_PROGRAMMING.title: 4-way forward programming
USE_4WAY_FORWARD_PROGRAMMING.summary: Forwards ESC programming traffic through the ESC sensor port.

USE_AUTO_ACKKNOWLEDGEMENT.title: NRF24 auto-acknowledge
USE_AUTO_ACKKNOWLEDGEMENT.summary: Option for the NRF24 INAV protocol.

USE_BIND_ADDRESS_FOR_DATA_STATE.title: NRF24 bind address
USE_BIND_ADDRESS_FOR_DATA_STATE.summary: Option for the NRF24 INAV protocol.

USE_VTX.title: Redpine VTX option
USE_VTX.summary: Used only by the Redpine SPI receiver protocol.

USE_RANGEFINDER_HCSR04.title: HC-SR04 sonar
USE_RANGEFINDER_HCSR04.summary: Driver for the HC-SR04 ultrasonic rangefinder. Needs USE_RANGEFINDER.

USE_RANGEFINDER_TF.title: Benewake TF lidar
USE_RANGEFINDER_TF.summary: Driver for Benewake TFmini/TF02 lidar. Needs USE_RANGEFINDER.
